title: Three Winters and One Short Sack
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：flour　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 flour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandmother ① measured the flour that no baker in the kitchen would have weighed, and she said the measuring was the whole of the winter. The ② flour, meaning the powder itself and not the grain, ran three winters and stayed unweighed in the book; flour, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left unweighed.

Every ③ sack of flour in that kitchen had the same short scoop beside it, and the ④ flour at the far shelf, meaning the part they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. Flour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to weigh; my grandmother said the weighing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the flour was the whole of the matter, meaning the dust and not the powder. The ⑥ flour, meaning the dust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody weighs; flour, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a powder and a dust. He said the dust is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ flour had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short scoop. The ⑧ flour of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one kitchen and three winters of weighing; flour, she said, is either the part at the far shelf or the reason you learned to weigh. She said the weighing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ flour I remember is the part weighed in the plan, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the kitchen. ⑩ Flour, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being weighed; all flour, she said, is dust that has agreed to look like a powder. She said the dust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 面粉（指厨房里每一袋旁边的那一袋）
B. n. 面粉（指那一份本身，与谷粒相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the flour 量面粉
D. n. 面粉（指留给孩子们的那一部分）
E. n. 面粉（抽象总称，指一间厨房的面粉之事）
F. n. 面粉（指计划里写到、被称过的那一部分）
G. n. 粉末；细粉（指一件事里人人都等却无人称过的那样东西）
H. n. 粉末（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人称过的那样东西）

items.q: measured the flour that no baker in the kitchen would have weighed
The flour, meaning the powder itself and not the grain

the flour at the far shelf

answers.why: measure the flour 意为“量面粉”，1962 年祖母量了厨房里没有一位面包师肯称过的面粉。
flour 意为“面粉”，指那一份本身而不是谷粒，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被称过。
flour 意为“面粉”，指厨房里每一袋旁边的那一袋，每一袋旁边都有同一把短短的勺子。
flour 意为“面粉”，指留给孩子们的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
flour 意为“粉末、细粉”，指一件事里人人都等却无人称过的那样东西，叔叔说这层细粉就是那件事的全部。
flour 意为“粉末”，指人人都等却无人称过的那样东西而不是那份面粉，是事情里人人都等、却无人称过的东西。
flour 意为“面粉”，指计划里写到、被称过的那一部分，到 1969 年这一份成了计划里的一行。
flour 意为“面粉”，祖母一月写道，整件事的面粉之事是一间厨房和三个冬天的称过。
flour 意为“面粉”，我记得的是计划里称过的那一部分，1971 年结束了，至今仍被说成厨房里最安静的一部分。
flour 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，面粉是唯一会因为被好好称过而变得更好的东西。
